news.text: Ryan Fitzgerald went four-of-four on his field-goal attempts in Sunday's 21-18 loss to the Cleveland Browns.
news.analysis: Fitzgerald looked good on Sunday. He made all four of his kicks against the Browns, including one from 53 yards out. He will likely continue to be a good but not great fantasy option moving forward.

news.text: Kalif Raymond caught six of his seven targets for 90 yards and a touchdown in a 27-7 win over the Eagles in Week 3.
news.analysis: Raymond's surprise involvement in the Chicago passing attack continues as he posted his most productive game of the season. The veteran wideout has caught 19 passes for 214 yards and a touchdown through three games while outproducing both Rome Odunze and Luther Burden III. Raymond will be a solid fantasy option in Week 4 against the Jets.

news.text: Chad Ryland connected on 3-of-3 field goal attempts and 3-of-3 extra point attempts on Sunday.
news.analysis: Ryland made field goals from 26, 41 and 49 yards out. His last field goal made the game one score in the final 40 seconds.

news.text: Matt Gay made 3-of-3 field goal attempts and 2-of-2 extra point attempts on Sunday.
news.analysis: Gay connected on field goals from 41, 37 and 25 yards out. He is 7-for-7 on field goal attempts through the first three games.

news.text: Cairo Santos made both of his field-goal attempts and added three extra points in a 27-7 win over the Eagles in Week 3's Monday night game.
news.analysis: Santos hit field goals from 29 and 48 yards out in the decisive victory over Philadelphia. The veteran kicker has made four of his five field-goal attempts and added 11 extra points through three games this year. He will take on the Jets in Week 4.

news.text: Noah Fant caught 4-of-4 targets for 33 yards and two touchdowns in the Saints 35-27 loss against the Raiders on Sunday.
news.analysis: Fant and Juwan Johnson both hauled in two touchdowns on the day. Despite that, Fant remains off the fantasy radar.

news.text: Drew Stevens converted both of his field goal attempts as well as 3-of-4 extra point attempts to finish with nine points in the Commanders' 33-31 Week 3 win over the Seattle Seahawks.
news.analysis: Stevens has battled consistency issues early on, missing an extra point attempt in two of the first three contests. The kicker will look to right the ship beginning in Week 4 against the Indianapolis Colts.

news.text: Andre Szmyt went 2-for-2 on his field-goal attempts and made his lone extra-point attempt in Sunday's 21-18 win over the Carolina Panthers.
news.analysis: The Browns were able to pick up a narrow win over the Panthers on Sunday, which Szmyt was able to help with by accounting for a third of the team's total points in this matchup. He doesn't project to be a good fantasy option at the position for the remainder of the season, however.

news.text: Cody White caught 1-of-3 targets for four yards and a touchdown in the Raiders 35-27 win over the Saints on Sunday.
news.analysis: White now has three touchdowns in the past two weeks coming off the practice squad. Still be remains off the fantasy radar.

news.text: Steelers DB Jalen Ramsey was spotted in a sling at Monday's practice.
news.analysis: It appears to be a new injury for Ramsey. His status will need to be monitored in practice ahead of Thursday's game against the Browns.

news.text: Case Keenum completed 24 of his 34 passes for 247 yards and two touchdowns while rushing for six yards and a touchdown on four carries in a 27-7 win over the Eagles in Week 3.
news.analysis: Keenum got the call with Caleb Williams (hamstring) and Tyson Bagent (concussion) both ailing and looked good in the Monday night win over Philly. He completed touchdown passes to Luther Burden III and Kalif Raymond in the contest. Bagent will likely be ready to return to action in Week 4 against the Jets, which will push Keenum to the backup role.

news.text: Dominic Zvada made all four of his field-goal attempts in Sunday's 12-7 win over the Tennessee Titans.
news.analysis: Zvada was one of the lone bright spots for New York on Sunday, making all four of his kicks and accounting for all of New York's points en route to a narrow win over the Titans. He isn't expected to be a good fantasy option at the kicker position moving forward, however.

news.text: Chris Moore caught his lone target for a four-yard touchdown in a 34-31 win over the Cowboys in Week 3.
news.analysis: Moore made the most of his lone catch, hauling in a touchdown pass in the third quarter to give Baltimore a 23-13 lead. The veteran wideout has not been a featured weapon in the Baltimore passing attack this year, catching three passes for 63 yards and a touchdown through three games. He will now prepare to take on the Titans in Week 4.

news.text: Riley Patterson converted his lone field goal attempt as well as his only extra point attempt to finish with four points in the Dolphins' 24-10 loss to the Kansas City Chiefs in Week 3.
news.analysis: Patterson has made the most of his opportunities behind an inconsistent Miami offense to begin the season, recording four or more points in each of the first three contests. The kicker remains difficult to trust behind an offense that will likely be without superstar running back De'Von Achane (knee), with a Week 4 contest against the Minnesota Vikings up next.

news.text: Daniel Carlson made 3-of-4 extra point attempts on Sunday.
news.analysis: Carlson did not attempt a field goal. He is 4-of-5 on field goal attempts to start the season.

news.text: Harrison Mevis went 4-for-4 on his field-goal attempts and made both of his extra-point attempts in Sunday night's 30-26 loss to the Denver Broncos.
news.analysis: Mevis was a bright spot for the Rams on Sunday night. He knocked down all six of his kicks against the Broncos, leaving him with a total of 14 points on the night. He should continue to be a good fantasy option at the position moving forward.

news.text: KaVontae Turpin caught one of his two targets for nine yards and ran for a nine-yard touchdown in a 34-31 loss to the Ravens in Brazil in Week 3.
news.analysis: Turpin showed his explosiveness as he found the end zone on a nine-yard run in the fourth quarter. He now has two catches for 17 yards and two carries for 10 yards through three games. He will take on the Texans in Week 4.

news.text: Green Bay Packers wide receiver Skyy Moore has seen his involvement in the offense grow with each passing week through the first three weeks of the 2026 campaign. Moore played just four offensive snaps in the season-opening loss to the division-rival Minnesota Vikings and failed to catch his lone target. In the Week 2 overtime win over the New York Jets, the 26-year-old played 36% of the offensive snaps and caught two of three targets for six yards. Moore's role expanded even more in Thursday ...
Roman Wilson caught 3-of-6 targets for 60 yards and a touchdown in a 30-27 win over the Bengals.
news.analysis: Wilson was expected to potentially see his playing time fall with the return of Michael Pittman, but the 25-year-old tallied his first touchdown of the season and a season high in receiving yards. Wilson will look to build on this performance against the Browns in Week 4.

news.text: The Vikings signed LB Kyle Van Noy to their active roster.
news.analysis: Van Noy will add depth in the linebacker room for Minnesota.

news.text: Rams head coach Sean McVay said CB Jaylen Watson dislocated his shoulder on Sunday.
news.analysis: Watson is expected to avoid injured reserve. He is week-to-week as of now.

news.text: Keenan Allen caught 6-of-9 targets for 63 yards and a touchdown in a 19-17 win over the Texans.
news.analysis: Allen turned in his best performance of the season and found the end zone for the first time as a Colt. With Alec Pierce (heel) on injured reserve, fantasy managers should expect Allen to see an increase in playing time. Allen and the Colts will take on the Commanders in Week 4.

news.text: Konata Mumpfield hauled in 4-of-8 targets for 93 yards and a touchdown in Sunday night's 30-26 loss to the Denver Broncos.
news.analysis: Mumpfield saw next to no action in the first two games of the season this year, but he was stellar on Sunday night. He stepped up and logged 93 yards and a touchdown in the absence of Puka Nacua (hip). He isn't expected to be a reliable fantasy asset moving forward, but if he continues to play well, that will add another dimension to QB Matthew Stafford's game moving forward.

news.text: Cooper Kupp caught four of his five targets for 46 yards and one touchdown in the Seahawks' 33-31 Week 3 loss to the Washington Commanders.
news.analysis: Kupp took advantage of increased involvement in the Seattle passing attack, recording more than two receptions for the first time in three contests Sunday. The wideout remains difficult to trust in all formats ahead of a Week 4 contest against the Los Angeles Chargers.

news.text: Mack Hollins hauled in 6-of-9 targets for 87 yards in Sunday's 35-6 blowout loss to the Jacksonville Jaguars.
news.analysis: Hollins was one of the lone bright spots for the Patriots on Sunday. He led the team in targets, receptions, and receiving yards against the Jaguars, but that wasn't enough to even keep things close against the Jaguars. He will continue to play a big role for the Patriots moving forward but shouldn't be trusted as a fantasy option at this point in the season.

news.text: Ryan Miller caught two of his three targets for 15 yards in the Dolphins' 24-10 loss to the Kansas City Chiefs in Week 3.
news.analysis: Miller has seen minimal involvement in the Miami offense to begin the season, recording three targets or less in each of the first three contests. The wideout remains best left off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 4 contest against the Minnesota Vikings.

news.text: Browns DB Tyson Campbell (ankle/hip) is officially inactive for a Week 3 matchup with Carolina.
news.analysis: Campbell was considered as questionable this week, but was dealing with multiple injuries and will not be available against the Panthers. Noah Igbinoghene and Mekhi Blackmon should see additional playing time with Campbell out.

news.text: The Bengals placed CB Jalen Davis on injured reserve.
news.analysis: Davis injured his hamstring in Sunday's loss to the Steelers. He will miss at least the next four games.

news.text: Jake Elliott was held to one extra point in a 27-7 loss to the Bears in Week 3.
news.analysis: Elliott did not attempt any field goals on a rough night for the Eagles on offense. The veteran kicker has now made both of his field-goal attempts and added seven extra points through three games this season. He will take on the Rams in Week 4.

news.text: Wil Lutz made both of his extra-point attempts but missed his lone field-goal attempt in Sunday's 30-26 win over the Los Angeles Rams.
news.analysis: Lutz wasn't able to do his job on Sunday night, missing his lone field in a close win over the Los Angeles Rams. He knocked in both of his extra-point attempts, but that wasn't enough to leave him with a good fantasy total on the night.

news.text: Cincinnati Bengals rookie wide receiver Dohnte Meyers had the best game of his young career in his team's Week 3 loss to the Pittsburgh Steelers, recording three catches for 29 yards on five targets. With Bengals wideout Andrei Iosivas (thumb) currently on Injured Reserve due to a thumb injury, Meyers appears to be the WR3 in Cincinnati behind star Bengals wide receivers Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins. As long as Chase and Higgins remain healthy, Meyers is unlikely to see enough consistent ...
Joey Slye missed his lone field-goal attempt but knocked in his lone extra-point attempt in Sunday's 12-7 loss to the New York Giants.
news.analysis: Slye didn't play well on Sunday, leaving three points out on the field with a missed field goal against the Giants. He will not be a good fantasy option at the kicker position moving forward.

news.text: Jaylin Lane caught his only target for 21 yards in the Commanders' 33-31 win over the Seattle Seahawks in Week 3.
news.analysis: Lane has struggled to make an impact to begin the season, finishing with one reception or less in each of the first three games. The wideout remains best left off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 4 contest against the Indianapolis Colts.

news.text: George Holani rushed three times for 10 yards while also hauling in all five of his targets for 48 yards in the Seahawks' 33-31 Week 3 loss to the Washington Commanders.
news.analysis: Holani has struggled to make an impact out of the backfield of late, recording less than 30 offensive yards in two of the first three games. The running back remains difficult to trust in all formats ahead of a Week 4 contest against the Los Angeles Chargers.

news.text: Xavier Hutchinson caught 3-of-6 targets for 51 yards in a 19-17 loss to the Colts.
news.analysis: Hutchinson was expected to step into a larger role with Nico Collins (hamstring) out of the lineup. The Houston offense struggled as a whole against the Colts and will look to pick up their first win of the season against Dallas in Week 4.

news.text: Tyler Higbee hauled in 8-of-11 targets for 62 yards and a touchdown in Sunday night's 30-26 loss to the Denver Broncos.
news.analysis: Higbee stepped up on Sunday night with Terrance Ferguson (ankle) injured for most of the game. The veteran finished with eight catches for 62 yards against the Broncos and was able to get into the end zone on one of those catches. He could have decent streaming value next week depending on the injury status of Ferguson and Puka Nacua (hip) in Week 4.

news.text: Kendrick Bourne caught 2-of-3 targets for 22 yards in the Cardinals 36-30 loss against the 49ers on Sunday.
news.analysis: Bourne has not been as involved the past two weeks after a big Week 1 performance. He remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

news.text: Brycen Tremayne caught 4-of-6 targets for 83 yards in Sunday's 21-18 loss to the Cleveland Browns.
news.analysis: Tremayne stepped up and ended up as Carolina's leading receiver with 83 yards on Sunday night. Jalen Coker (quad) is now dealing with an injury for the Panthers, so if he misses time, Tremayne will likely continue to be an involved member of this offense for the next game or two at least.

news.text: Jeremy Ruckert caught all five of his targets for 39 yards and a touchdown in a 31-24 loss to the Lions.
news.analysis: Ruckert caught a four-yard pass early in the fourth quarter for his first touchdown of the season. The 26-year-old will likely continue to serve as the second tight end as long as Mason Taylor (thumb) is forced to miss time.

news.text: Giants RB Devin Singletary is officially inactive for a Week 3 matchup with the Titans.
news.analysis: Singletary is a healthy inactive for the Giants after averaging just 2.8 yards per carry in the first two games. Najee Harris will serve as the primary backup to Cam Skattebo.

news.text: Panthers CB Jaycee Horn suffered a torn quad and is out indefinitely.
news.analysis: Horn will seek a second opinion, but he's headed for the Injured Reserve. There is some concern he could be out for the season, a brutal loss for the Panthers defense.

news.text: John Metchie III caught 2-of-5 targets for 19 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 21-18 loss to the Cleveland Browns.
news.analysis: Metchie was able to make his mark on Sunday, scoring Carolina's lone touchdown in a loss to the Browns. Fantasy managers shouldn't expect much out of him moving forward, however, especially if Jalen Coker (quad) is able to make his return in the near future.

news.text: Matt Hibner caught both of his targets for 23 yards and a touchdown in a 34-31 win over the Cowboys in Week 3.
news.analysis: Hibner found the end zone on a two-yard pass from Lamar Jackson to put the Ravens up 30-28 in the fourth quarter. The rookie tight end has caught three passes for 36 yards and one touchdown through three games. He will now get ready to face the Titans in Week 4.

news.text: Greg Dulcich caught five of his seven targets for 55 yards in the Dolphins' 24-10 loss to the Kansas City Chiefs in Week 3.
news.analysis: Dulcich has struggled to make an impact in the Miami offense early in the season, finishing with less than 20 receiving yards in two of three contests. The tight end remains one of many risky pass-catching options held back by an underwhelming Dolphins offense to this point, with a Week 4 matchup against the Minnesota Vikings up next.

news.text: Darnell Washington caught 3-of-4 targets for 67 yards in a 30-27 win over the Bengals.
news.analysis: Washington saw the bulk of his production come on a 47-yard reception. The 25-year-old continues to compete with Pat Freiermuth for targets, with neither option being trustworthy heading into a Week 4 matchup with the Browns.

news.text: Ben Skowronek caught his lone target for 23 yards and a touchdown in a 30-27 win over the Bengals.
news.analysis: The 29-year-old veteran made the most of his lone target Sunday. Fantasy managers can leave Skowronek on the waiver wire for now.

news.text: Brady Russell caught his only target for 20 yards in the Seahawks' 33-31 loss to the Washington Commanders in Week 3.
news.analysis: Russell has seen minimal involvement in the Seattle offense to begin the season, finishing with two targets or less in each of the first three games. The tight end can remain off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 4 contest against the Los Angeles Chargers.

news.text: Rams head coach Sean McVay said the team is hopeful Kamren Kinchens will return this week against the Eagles.
news.analysis: Kinchens is working his way back from a hamstring injury.

news.text: DeMario Douglas caught 1-of-5 targets for 38 yards in Sunday's 35-6 loss to the Jacksonville Jaguars.
news.analysis: Douglas had a tough time connecting with QB Drake Maye on Sunday, catching just one of his five targets for a 38-yard gain. He will continue to see a solid amount of targets on a week-to-week basis moving forward but carries very little fantasy upside for the foreseeable future.

news.text: Ed Oliver (hip) is active for Week 3 for the Buffalo Bills against the Los Angeles Chargers according to Cameron Wolfe.
news.analysis: Oliver takes the field after clearing through pregame activities without any setbacks, boosting a Buffalo front seven that will look to disrupt a Chargers offense still looking for some consistency entering the Week 3 contest.

news.text: Panthers WR Xavier Legette (knee) is officially inactive for a Week 3 matchup with the Browns.
news.analysis: Legette was a late add to the Panthers' injury report on Thursday and was limited on Friday. Brycen Tremayne and John Metchie will see increased playing time behind Tetairoa McMillan and Jalen Coker.

news.text: Justice Hill carried the ball five times for 33 yards in a 34-31 win over the Cowboys in Week 3.
news.analysis: Hill averaged 6.6 yards per carry in the exciting win over Dallas in Rio de Janeiro on Sunday. The veteran running back continues to mix in behind starter Derrick Henry, with Week 3 being his most productive game of the season. Hill will not be a strong fantasy option heading into a Week 4 matchup against the Titans.

news.text: Ryan Flournoy caught two of his eight targets for 22 yards in a 34-31 loss to the Ravens in Brazil in Week 3.
news.analysis: Flournoy didn't do much damage through the air but he drew an encouraging eight targets in the loss. If he can continue to get that type of work consistently, Flournoy might work his way into the flex conversation in fantasy leagues. For now, he's best left on the bench heading into a Week 4 matchup against a tough Houston Texans defense.

news.text: Treylon Burks caught both of his targets for 13 yards and one touchdown in the Commanders' 33-31 win over the Seattle Seahawks in Week 3.
news.analysis: Burks has made minimal impact in the Washington passing attack early on, finishing with less than 15 receiving yards in each of his two games. The wideout remains difficult to trust in all formats ahead of a Week 4 matchup against the Indianapolis Colts.

news.text: Eric Saubert caught one of his two targets for 13 yards and one touchdown in the Seahawks' 33-31 loss to the Washington Commanders in Week 3.
news.analysis: Saubert remains minimally involved in the Seattle passing attack early on, recording less than two receptions in each of the first three contests. The tight end remains best left off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 4 contest against the Los Angeles Chargers.

news.text: The Giants signed WR Braxton Berrios to their 53-man roster.
news.analysis: Berrios will figure to make an impact on special teams for the Giants.

news.text: AJ Dillon rushed the ball four times for 16 yards and caught one pass for -2 yards in Sunday's 21-18 loss to the Cleveland Browns.
news.analysis: Dillon is now involved for the Panthers with Jonathan Brooks (core) out of the lineup for the foreseeable future. The veteran wasn't able to do much on Sunday, however, racking up just 14 total yards on five touches. Chuba Hubbard will continue to be the only back with value on this offense for the foreseeable future.

news.text: Ty Johnson hauled in each of his four targets for 50 yards in the Bills' 24-16 Week 3 win over the Los Angeles Chargers.
news.analysis: Johnson found a way to make an impact in his first game action of the season, finishing second on the team in receiving yards in the win. The running back remains an impactful pass-catching option out of the backfield when healthy, with a Week 4 contest against the New England Patriots up next.

news.text: Alec Ingold caught three of his four targets for 35 yards in the Chargers' 24-16 loss to the Buffalo Bills in Week 3.
news.analysis: Ingold has been non-existent in the Los Angeles passing attack to begin the season, seeing his first targets in three games in Sunday's loss. The fullback can be left off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 4 matchup against the Seattle Seahawks.

news.text: The Vikings placed TE Josh Oliver on injured reserve.
news.analysis: Oliver was slated to undergo surgery. He will miss at least the next four games.

news.text: Noah Gray caught all three of his targets for 39 yards in the Chiefs' 24-10 win over the Miami Dolphins in Week 3.
news.analysis: Gray has struggled to make an impact in the Kansas City passing attack to begin the season, finishing with less than 40 receiving yards in each of the first three contests. The tight end remains best left off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 4 divisional contest against the Las Vegas Raiders.

news.text: Tyrone Tracy Jr. rushed the ball just one time for three yards in Sunday's 12-7 win over the Tennessee Titans.
news.analysis: It looks like the veteran has been nearly entirely phased out of this offense. He saw just one opportunity on Sunday and was completely outmatched by Najee Harris, who himself saw nine. Tracy won't be a relevant name in this backfield for the foreseeable future.

news.text: 49ers coach Kyle Shanahan said he hopes that Romello Height is back against the Broncos.
news.analysis: Height was sidelined this past week after going down with a hand injury. His status will need to be monitored in practice throughout the week.

news.text: Colson Yankoff caught one of his two targets for two yards in the Commanders' 33-31 win over the Seattle Seahawks in Week 3.
news.analysis: Yankoff has been an afterthought in the Washington passing attack early on, recording two targets or less in each of his two contests. The tight end can be left off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 4 contest against the Indianapolis Colts.

news.text: The Bengals released WR/KR Ke'Shawn Williams.
news.analysis: Cincinnati signed WR Mitchell Tinsley as the corresponding move.

news.text: Steelers CB Brandin Echols has entered the league's concussion protocol.
news.analysis: Echols was injured in Week 3's win over the Bengals. He will almost certainly be sidelined this week with the Steelers playing on Thursday against the Browns.

news.text: John Bates caught his lone target for nine yards in the Commanders' 33-31 win over the Seattle Seahawks in Week 3.
news.analysis: Bates has underwhelmed to begin the season, recording two catches or less in each of his three contests. The tight end remains another risky pass-catching option in the Washington offense early on, with a Week 4 contest against the Indianapolis Colts up next.

news.text: Ben Sinnott failed to catch his only target in the Commanders' 33-31 win over the Seattle Seahawks in Week 3.
news.analysis: Sinnott has been non existent in the Washington offense to begin the season, recording one target or less in each of the first three games. The tight end remains best left off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 4 contest against the Indianapolis Colts.

news.text: Tyson Bagent (concussion) is active for the Chicago Bears against the Philadelphia Eagles according to Ian Rapoport.
news.analysis: Bagent will suit up after clearing through concussion protocol at the end of last week, likely backing up veteran signal-caller Case Keenum against the Eagles for head coach Ben Johnson Monday night.

news.text: The Bengals signed TE Tanner Hudson to their active roster.
news.analysis: Hudson will add depth in the tight end room for Cincinnati.

Goodson only played 11 offensive snaps (15%) behind starter Javonte Williams, and he had six carries for 22 yards while catching his only target in the passing game for a loss of five yards. Coming into Week 4, Donaldson has carried the ball four times for 11 yards, while hauling in one reception for -2 yards. Usually, Donaldson is an afterthought in the backfield, but he could see an expanded role with Travis Etienne Jr. (hamstring) expected to miss some time. Alvin Kamara should be the lead back with Kendre Miller and Donaldson splitting up ...
Ifeatu Melifonwu reached agreement on a one-year deal with the Bucs.
news.analysis: Melifonwu earns a spot on the active roster after three elevations from the practice squad.

news.text: Marvin Mims Jr. (foot) is inactive for Week 3 for the Denver Broncos against the Los Angeles Rams.
news.analysis: Mims Jr. will not suit up after entering the weekend carrying a questionable designation for head coach Sean Payton, leaving Jaylen Waddle, Courtland Sutton, and Troy Franklin as the primary pass-catching options against the Rams Sunday night.

news.text: The Rams waived Tanner Ingle.
news.analysis: Ingle will figure to seek another opportunity.

news.text: Dyami Brown failed to catch his only target in the Commanders' 33-31 win over the Seattle Seahawks in Week 3.
news.analysis: Brown has seen minimal involvement in the Washington offense early on, posting two targets or less in two of the first three games. The wideout remains best left off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 4 contest against the Indianapolis Colts.

news.text: Jackson Hawes failed to catch his only target in the Bills' 24-16 win over the Los Angeles Chargers in Week 3.
news.analysis: Hawes has been non-existent in the Buffalo offense to begin the season, seeing his first target in three games Sunday. The tight end can remain off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 4 contest against the New England Patriots.

news.text: Marquez Valdes-Scantling failed to catch his only target in the Chargers' 24-16 loss to the Buffalo Bills in Week 3.
news.analysis: Valdes-Scantling saw minimal involvement in the passing attack after being added to the active roster earlier in the week, finishing last on the team in targets. The veteran wideout can remain off rosters in all formats, with a Week 4 contest against the Seattle Seahawks up next.

news.text: The Giants released WR Odell Beckham Jr.
news.analysis: Beckham had seen just one target through three games to start the season.

news.text: Jalon Daniels is set to be Tampa Bay's starting quarterback for the next three weeks at least.
news.analysis: Daniels, an undrafted rookie out of Kansas, is set to be Tampa Bay's starting quarterback with Baker Mayfield (thumb) expected to miss a minimum of three weeks. He is unlikely to have any fantasy value himself, and it remains to be seen if he will play well enough to support the fantasy value of Bucky Irving and Emeka Egbuka over the next few weeks, but he will have a good opportunity to prove himself in an easy matchup against Green Bay's struggling defense in Week 4.

news.text: The Vikings traded J.J. McCarthy to the Giants on Monday for a fifth-round pick.
news.analysis: McCarthy's tenure in Minnesota was a rocky one, with injuries and underperformance plaguing the start of his career. However, he may find more opportunity in New York due to the absence of Jaxson Dart and the team's interest in possibly giving McCarthy a shot at the starting job; otherwise, he will serve as Jameis Winston's backup. He can stay on the fantasy waiver wire unless he lands the starting job.

news.text: Steelers DB Joey Porter Jr. (back) is officially inactive for a Week 3 matchup with the Bengals.
news.analysis: Porter was listed as questionable to play and will now have to wait at least one more week to make his season debut. This is a big boost for the Bengals' offense as the Steelers will be without a key piece of their secondary.

news.text: The Vikings released Jerome Ford.
news.analysis: Ford will figure to seek another opportunity.

news.text: Free-agent running back Kareem Hunt is a pure speculation stash for Week 4, but the timing makes him more interesting than he was a week ago. Injuries have hit several backfields around the league, and Hunt is still unsigned after spending 2025 with Kansas City. He appeared in all 17 games last season, rushing 163 times for 611 yards and eight touchdowns while adding 18 catches for 143 yards and another score. There is no confirmed visit or landing spot yet, so this is not a pickup for managers ...
The Titans signed RB Michael Carter to their active roster.
news.analysis: Carter will add depth in the backfield for Tennessee.

news.text: The 49ers signed DE Matt Judon.
news.analysis: Judon will join the 49ers' practice squad. He will likely be elevated next week.

news.text: The Browns signed CB Myles Bryant to their practice squad.
news.analysis: Bryant will add depth in the secondary for Cleveland.

news.text: The Giants waived QB Jake Haener.
news.analysis: This is the corresponding move to the Giants trading for J.J. McCarthy. Haener is expected to re-sign with the Giants practice squad.

news.text: The Titans signed LB Owen Pappoe to their practice squad.
news.analysis: Pappoe will add depth in the linebacker room for Tennessee.

news.text: The Bengals are signing WR Mitch Tinsley off the Texans practice.
news.analysis: Tinsley will be added to the active roster for Cincinnati. He'll add depth in the Bengals wide receiver room.

news.text: The 49ers hosted WR Brenden Rice for a workout.
news.analysis: Rice will compete to earn a depth role in the 49ers wide receiver room.

news.text: The Vikings signed QB Max Brosmer to the 53-man roster.
news.analysis: Brosmer will add depth in the quarterback room for Minnesota.
